thread:
mike: Quick preflight — planning a short CB perf run on staging, want to try max_batch=128 and see if tail latency improves for long sequences. I'll kick loadgen at 11:30 PT.
anya: What model + max_tokens for the run? we should keep it realistic (prod-ish prompts).
sam: If we raise max_batch we should reduce batch_timeout to avoid added latency for short requests. suggest timeout=15ms as a starting point.
jia: Also add the short-seq bypass we discussed — for steps < 32 tokens route to fast-path, otherwise go to continuous batch. Without it kv-cache thrash kills perf.
mike: Good call. running with model=gpt-3.5-open-quant and max_tokens=512. config I plan to use:
```json
{
  "max_batch": 128,
  "batch_timeout_ms": 15,
  "short_seq_threshold": 32,
  "max_tokens": 512
}
```
sam: Also set max_queue_len to 1024 so we keep throughput for sustained bursts — but watch OOM.
loadgen-bot: loadgen scheduled: staging/cb-run-2026-03-18T11:30Z (id: lg-7821). results will land in /perf/runs/lg-7821.json.
anya: Ping me once it's done, I'll run the regression evals and diff against baseline run 2026-03-10-lg-7700.
mike: One more ask — can someone review PR #2345 (cb: bump cap + short-seq) before I deploy? small change in runtime/batcher.cc. Link: https://git.redwood/infer/pulls/2345 :eyes:
sam: I'll take a look in ~30m. quick scan shows we need an assertion to protect empty KV cache case.
jia: If the run shows tail latency > 2x at p99 we should abort and rollback to max_batch=64. add a health-check that fails the rollout if p99_latency > 2x baseline.
mike: noted. I'll add the health-check to the rollout policy. thanks all. :thumbsup:
